COMMUNITY_CALLING.SETUP_DESCRIPTION: Enable calling for a WhatsApp Cloud inbox.
COMMUNITY_CALLING.ADMIN_SETUP: Ask an administrator to enable calling for this inbox.

ERRORS.MICROPHONE_DENIED: Allow microphone access in your browser settings, then try again.
ERRORS.MICROPHONE_MISSING: Connect a microphone before starting a WhatsApp call.
ERRORS.BROWSER_UNSUPPORTED: This browser cannot start a WhatsApp call.
ERRORS.SDP_GATHERING: Could not complete the secure connection. Try again.
ERRORS.CONNECTION_TIMEOUT: The call did not connect. Check your network and try again.
ERRORS.RING_TIMEOUT: The call was not answered. Try again when the contact is available.
ERRORS.ACCOUNT_CHANGED: Your account changed before the call could start. Try again.
ERRORS.PERMISSION_REQUIRED: Call permission is required before you can call this contact.
ERRORS.PERMISSION_PERMANENT: This contact must approve WhatsApp calls from your business before you can call.
ERRORS.PERMISSION_TEMPORARY: Wait until the temporary call restriction ends, then try again.
ERRORS.PERMISSION_REQUESTED: Call permission was requested. Try again after the contact approves it.
ERRORS.RING_BLOCKED: Your browser blocked call audio. Answer the call or allow sound for this site.
